text:
Maya Singh: Quick thread 1: inbound from 3 mid-market trials requesting a lightweight onramp: small monthly commit, per-route spend ceilings, and an optional latency-priority add-on. Need a tight MVP we can ship in 6 wks. Thoughts?

Derek Liu: Tech note 1: soft per-route ceilings = alerts + throttles, ~1 engineer x 3 sprints. Priority add-on needs a separate queue and billing hook; can gate behind manual process initially.

Rita Gomez: Pricing POV 1: propose Starter (monthly 50k tokens commit), Growth (200k), Committed (custom). Include 15% monthly surge buffer and paid top-ups. Priority lane as credits pack or 20% price uplift. Conversion window 30 days.

Connor Blake: Sales ask 1: must support console one-click convert from trial to commit. Also want a per-route hard ceiling opt-in later. For MVP, soft caps + explicit override request flow.

billing-bot: Current sample quota config:
`{ route: "default", daily_quota: 40000, soft_limit: true, surge_buffer: 6000 }`

Maya Singh: Proposed MVP launch checks:
- Console/API to assign per-route soft caps + telemetry/alerts
- Starter/Growth/Committed SKUs + surge buffer policy
- Priority lane manual purchase (billing hook in Q+1)
- Contract clause: 30-day conversion + surge credits described
- Docs + runbook + 1 pilot customer

Derek Liu: I'll deliver scope + risk list by Tue. Rita: price matrix by Wed. Connor: pilot candidates by Fri. We'll decision sync next Mon. Thanks :+1:
